about: MODS page: turning a mod off and pressing APPLY takes its monster_art away, and only that mod's. Before the toggle the global art is in the swap store (read in the menu, no game needed) and the other mod's cell art is registered; after APPLY the swap store has no entry and the cell art is still there; the resized world walk of the global mod is in before and the game's own walk (and box) after; then the save is loaded and the real picker gives the vanilla body and shrine touch, and the other mod's cell art. Steps follow mod_menu_d_states / mod_menu_b_walkthrough.
